Traffic Advisory if you are driving to Sacramento area. 

BREAKING: Firefighters and first responders are on the scene of a medical helicopter that crashed on highway 50 at  Stockton Blvd in Sacramento.  via @916times 

People are reportedly trapped inside. Helpful citizens rushed to their aid. The crash happened around 7:22pm. 🚁 🛣️ 

Firefighters can be heard saying “All three are still alive.” 

Helicopter that crashed on 50 identified as N414RX or Reach Air Medical Services. Departed UC Davis Medical center in Elmhurst before crashing onto 50. 📸 @916times
